ankiExport.duplicateRejection: A second and third Add on the same term were refused and the buttons reported 'Already in Anki'; the deck still held exactly one note.

residueLeftBehind.why: The first version of phase5-anki-probe.mjs added a temporary *custom* profile. A custom profile's note type is always derived from its label (shared/profiles.ts makeCustomProfile builds `JP Study App::Custom::<label>`, and main/profiles.ts mergeAnkiBinding resets any stored modelName that differs from it, treating it as a legacy migration), so the run provisioned a new note type. AnkiConnect exposes no deleteModel action, so it could not be removed programmatically and the collection DB was deliberately not edited by hand.
residueLeftBehind.userAction: Remove it in Anki: Tools > Manage Note Types > select 'JP Study App::Custom::Phase 5 manga probe (temporary)' > Delete. It holds 0 notes.
residueLeftBehind.fixed: phase5-anki-probe.mjs now redirects seed-ja-immersion's deckName instead of adding a profile, leaving the shipped note type untouched. The arm/disarm round trip was re-verified and both files hash-matched the backup afterwards.

defectsFound.severity: real; found by this run, fixed with tests
defectsFound.symptom: The reader's Auto-translate wrote _ocr/0001.tr.en.json and 0002.tr.en.json whose lines are the untouched Japanese, and both pages counted as translated.
defectsFound.firstDiagnosisWasWrong: It was recorded as 'translateRun echoes the source', on the strength of window.api.translateRun({text:'猫が窓辺で寝ている。',from:'ja',to:'en'}) → {ok:true, text:'猫が窓辺で寝ている。'}. That probe passed from/to where the API takes source/target, so undefined === undefined took a same-language short-circuit. Loading the same GGUF directly from Node with the shipped buildSentencePrompt returns 'A cat is sleeping on the window ledge.' in ~800ms — the model was never the problem. Recorded because this is the project's recurring failure mode, applied to itself.
realCauses: translateText compared the language pair without validating it, so a missing or unknown code returned the source text as a successful translation.
translateSentence never applied isValidCrossLangTranslation, which the batch path always had — a model echo would have passed as a translation.

The one that produced these caches: translateMokuroPage returned the page unchanged when no region translated, and analyzeMangaVolume cached it regardless, so refreshMangaOcrMeta counted it as translated. Nothing surfaced because runTranslationBatch reports a failed item as an empty string rather than by throwing.
defectsFound.fix: All three corrected. Covered by src/main/__tests__/translateGuards.test.ts (4 tests) and src/main/__tests__/mangaOcrTranslateCache.test.ts (4 tests). A partly-failed analyze now returns a `warning` that MangaReader displays.

defectsFound.what: Immediately after 'Download and read' the .reader element sat in flow below the desktop shell (document height 2114 for a 1057 viewport) rather than over it, so the reader was off-screen until the layout settled.
defectsFound.context: It resolved on its own within a few seconds and the reader then occupied the viewport at y=0. Recorded because it was observed, not diagnosed.
